spans.s: 1. वि—स्मय mfn. (for 2. see वि-√ स्मि) free from pride or arrogance, BhP.; Śiś.
2. वि-स्मय m. (for 1. see p. 953, col. 1) wonder, surprise, amazement, bewilderment, perplexity (in rhet. one of the स्थायि-भावs, q.v.), MBh.; Kāv.; Daśar.
pride, arrogance, Mn.; BhP.
doubt, uncertainty, W.

वि-√ स्मि Ā. -स्मयते (mc. also P.), to wonder, be surprised or astonished at (instr. loc., or abl.), ŚBr. &c. &c.;
to be proud of (instr.), Mn. iv, 236 :
Caus. -स्माययति, or -स्मापयति, ˚ते (cf. Pāṇ. i, 3, 68; vi, 1, 57),
to astonish, surprise, MBh.; Kāv. &c. :
Desid. of Caus. See वि-सिस्मापयिषु.

वि-√ स्मृ P. -स्मरति (mc. also Ā.), to forget, be unmindful of (acc. or gen.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Pass. -स्मर्यते (aor. व्य्-अस्मारि), to be forgotten, Rājat. :
Caus. -स्मारयति (fut. -स्मारयिष्यते), to cause to forget, Vikr. iii, 18 :
Desid. of Caus. See वि-सिस्मारयिषु.
the act of forgetting, oblivion, Kap.; Śak.
